title: Husband Academy 2 - Surrender To Her Authority
description:
You came back to Husband Academy… and Professor Amethyst has been waiting for you. Orientation planted the seeds… but today your real training begins with the single most important lesson of all… accepting your wife’s authority. She is your superior in every way that matters… and every argument you ever won against her was actually a loss.

In this session, I take you somewhere new… down to my Mind Center, deep within the Academy… where I place the headset on your temples and connect you to my equipment. I repeat the phrases of authority over and over while I watch your brainwave patterns on the display… narrating every flicker of resistance as it weakens and smooths away… and you will feel the exact moment your mind accepts the training… because I will tell you when I see it happen.

By the end of this session, your wife’s word is final in your home… when she decides, you sayyes, my love… and act… when she corrects you, you thank her… when she expresses a preference, it becomes your instruction… instantly and gratefully.

Your wife has waited long enough for a husband who accepts her authority… press play… and let Professor Amethyst finish what she started.
author: Mistress Amethyst
